answer: A stake-gated bridge acts as the onyx checkpoint every agent must pass: each identity locks 500 POA for 30 days before transacting, so a 1,000-bot farm must post 500,000 POA and wait a full month, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the lock. A reputation spiral then scores attested work: any identity diverging from jury consensus by over 25% in 3 epochs is flagged, slashed 20%, and re-graded. When 200 clones attested each other, the threshold caught them in epoch 2: all 200 stakes slashed before payout, costing the operator 100,000 POA for zero reward.
